rng: numpy.random.default_rng / PCG64; trial_seed as stored in experiments.py
noise: Independent Gaussian noise per point/component, std = ratio * clean component RMS

lasso.normalization: Z=G/column_RMS, y=b/response_RMS; no centering, no extra intercept
lasso.selection: matrix-2-norm OLS projection difference / OLS projection norm + nonzero fraction; smallest ratio breaks ties
lasso.coefficients: Penalized coefficients, restored to physical units; no OLS support refit
lasso.support: Exact solver zeros; no coefficient cutoff
lasso.solver: scikit-learn LARS Gram path; primal active-set polishing first, then coordinate descent fallback and final polishing if KKT error exceeds 1e-7*alpha_max
lasso.validation: Every candidate must satisfy max coordinate KKT violation / alpha_max <= 1e-7
lasso.inputs: Weak G and b only; no true coefficients, support or clean observations

selection_rule: LASSO penalized path / WSINDy projection-support loss
